name: Ningbo Shanshan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Shanshan Co.,Ltd. provides lithium battery materials in China, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers lithium-ion battery materials; cathode materials, such as lithium cobalt oxide products, multi-material series products, lithium manganese oxide products, NCA ternary material, and ternary precursors; and anode material products, including synthetic and natural graphite, mesophase carbon microbeads, composite graphite, and silicon anode materials. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ningbo, the People's Republic of China.
